title: Keep scrolling. Just don't leave wired. That's the idea behind DeRot, a calm reset app for

copy.instagram_caption:
Keep scrolling. Just don't leave wired.

Your apps wind you up. DeRot brings you back down. We pause your apps while you reset with a few calming breaths, then send you back feeling more like yourself.

It's almost here. Join the launch list (link in bio) and we'll tell you the day it's live.

images.alt: A calm reset for the apps that wind you up. DeRot is coming soon to iPhone. Join the launch list at derot.org.
